name: TroopRally API
description: Read and manage rallies, slots, bookings, and poll responses. Generate a key under Settings → Integrations (Pro plan required) and see https://trooprally.com/integrations for authentication details and examples. Each key is rate-limited to 300 requests per 60-second window; exceeding it returns 429 with a Retry-After header (see TooManyRequests). What changed in 1.4.0: the Group Poll confirmation endpoints no longer take a note. A request with a non-empty note is refused with 400; put anything respondents should know in the poll's onlineMeetingDetails, which the confirmation emails include. What changed in 1.3.0: reminder emails. Every rally gains reminderOffsetsMinutes (when, before a booked time, attendees get a reminder email). Creating a Registration Sheet or Booking Agent turns them on at 1 day before unless the request says otherwise, and confirming or changing a Group Poll's time can set them for everyone who said yes or maybe. What changed in 1.2.0: confirming a Group Poll's time can also add it to the organizer's own calendar (addToCalendar, on by default), and a later change or cancellation moves or removes that event. What changed in 1.1.0: a Group Poll's final time can be confirmed, changed, or canceled with POST/PUT/DELETE /v1/rallies/group-polls/{id}/confirmation. A rally's status can now be "confirmed" (a Group Poll with a confirmed time; voting is closed) -- clients that switch on status should handle it. Every rally gains confirmedSlot and confirmedAt.
